name: mail2000
description: Search recent Mail2000 mail from a local cache in the runtime workspace, using the Bot's governed Mail2000 connector.

interface.shortDescription: Fast local search over recent Mail2000 mail.
interface.longDescription: Syncs recent Mail2000 envelopes into the runtime workspace through the Bot's Mail2000 MCP connection and searches them locally with the m2k CLI. Reading full mail stays a read-only connector call; sending and changing mail stay with the connector tools.
defaultPrompt: 找出最近兩週跟國泰有關的信
